newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa Cargo says wants transparent prices.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa Cargo says wants transparent prices.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG (LCAG), the cargo subsidiary of Deutsche Lufthansa AG, said it plans to disclose air cargo rates as part of a new logistics strategy.
LCAG chairman Wilhelm Althen said the airline planned to disclose net rates to air cargo shippers who at present often only had access to forwarders' rates.
"We want to have transparent prices which do not exist at present. Why should shippers not know what the price is?" he said at a news conference.
"We want to communicate our prices to the shippers, so they know what the service of Lufthansa Cargo is," he added.
In response to a Reuters question, Althen agreed such a move would result in transparent rates composed of Lufthansa Cargo net prices and separate forwarders' prices.
Michael Kraus, LCAG business development manager, said shippers could then see the price of each service within the logistics chain.
Joachim Haas, LCAG senior vice-president Europe & Africa, said it would make sense to publish rates which included the forwarders' profit margin.
Althen added that Lufthansa Cargo already had contract prices with about one-third of large clients, separate forwarders' prices and ad-hoc rates.
"We have direct contracts with most large clients and the forwarders handle the business," he explained.
Prices would in future be differentiated according to the service and type of good carried, he said.
Althen said Lufthansa Cargo currently sold 80 percent through forwarders but declined to say how much this could change in future through alternative sales methods.
"In future it depends on what the shippers want. Joint marketing is increasingly important," he noted.

Air cargo forwarders officially earn a six percent commission on sales but in practice shipper prices vary between net airline rates and effective double-figure commission levels, market observers noted. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
